==Description==
The '''Minigunner Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the Default Level 1 [[Minigunner]]. Anybody who bought the toy would be emailed a code 24 hours later, which allowed them to get the [[Minigunner/Gallery#Plushie|{{Color|Other|Plushie}}]] skin for the [[Minigunner]]. This is no longer the case after the 18th of May 2025.

The mask and minigun of the '''Minigunner Plush''' is detachable. It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton, it is 8.6 inches (21.844 cm) tall and 8.2 inches (20.828 cm) wide. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Minigunner Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:The Iconic Minigunner Plush is here! The Minigunner Plush has a detachable mask and gun so it's always ready to fight the enemy. 

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Minigunner Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $34.99. It is currently unavailable.

Before April 2025, it could be purchased for $29.99. Before April 2023, it could be purchased for $27.99. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it could be bought for $22.49.
